labeler: Codex CLI 0.155.1, model gpt-5.6-luna (reasoning effort medium)
method: Blind pass over packet.json in 9 chunks of 5 cases. Each chunk ran in a bubblewrap sandbox whose only project content was that chunk, with a fresh CODEX_HOME (auth only), web search, browser, apps and computer use disabled, and Codex's own read-only sandbox. The prompt is codex_run/prompt.txt.
audit: codex_run/events/ holds every Codex event: 9 agent messages and no tool calls, file reads or web access. 209,032 input and 9,510 output tokens.
supersedes: The labels.json first committed in PR #2 were not independent: they were written by a script that copied the reference labels (_truth) into labels.json, which is why every kappa was 1.00. They were replaced by this run.
